first_5_seconds: Verified live in the Browser pane at 375x812: entering the chapter shows the task-bar status line (今日の月・締め切り・予報) and 3 variety cards immediately, all interactive with no explanatory paragraph — matches first_5_seconds_v2.json/no_manual_requirements.
touch_targets: join/dx-derived .dx-commit (variety commit button) min-height 44px, .dx-more ('?' pattern disclosure) is a 38x38px circle (same as clue_join's DiagnoseGame.tsx precedent, reused verbatim via shared CSS classes) — all meet the 44px/38px conventions already established in this app.
mobile_375: Measured live via screenshot at 375x812: single-column stack of 3 variety cards + task-bar + disclaimer line all render with generous vertical margin left over (well under one screen), no horizontal scroll.
direct_manipulation: Each variety card's '?' toggle and 'これでまく' commit button are direct taps with immediate visual feedback (pattern text open/close, card border highlight) — verified live via click-and-read in the Browser pane.
reaction_timing: State updates (pattern disclosure, outcome resolution) render synchronously on tap with no artificial delay, consistent with every other Q1 game in this app.
c_to_d: Verified: the task-bar status line (today's month / deadline / forecast) and the 3 variety cards' pattern text (sowing window / harvest days / heat tolerance, opened via '?') are the only information available; the child must compare them and commit — the component never auto-suggests or highlights the correct variety (gameplay-qa-sow-grow.mjs source-level check confirms no CORRECT-variety hint appears before commit).
consequence: A winning commit shows a distinct success screen naming the chosen variety and confirming all 3 conditions matched; a losing commit shows a distinct honest-partial screen with a flat, non-diagnostic message (no hint which of season/deadline/heat failed) — verified live for both paths, and confirmed the partial path calls onPartialComplete (a real implementation bug was found live-testing where it initially called onComplete directly, rendering the SAME success-framed Job Reveal chip for a wrong answer — fixed, and a source-level regression check added to gameplay-qa-sow-grow.mjs).
retry: By design (game_translations_v5.json's retry_or_rethink, reasoned and confirmed sound by design review r4/r5's independent verdict), there is no same-session retry — a wrong commit resolves immediately to the honest partial screen. A genuine do-over requires replaying the chapter (a freshly re-randomized session). Verified live: committing a variety immediately transitions to success or partial, no in-place re-selection is offered.
answer_leak: gameplay-qa-sow-grow.mjs verifies: variety names contain no season kanji (春/夏/秋/冬); the component never redeclares its own variety data (imports from farmLogic.ts only, so no drifted duplicate); no fixed month/deadline/forecast literal from the old implementation remains in code (only in a historical comment). Live testing confirmed the '?' pattern disclosure never reveals or implies which variety is correct.
brute_force: gameplay-qa-sow-grow.mjs: every fixed-variety memorization strategy (always_plant_tsubutane/manmaru/kotone) wins under 42% of sessions (N=8000); content-blind random guessing (39.9%) stays well below full reasoning (100%, by construction every session is solvable); no variety wins 100% of any multi-candidate month's own accepted states (mirrors design-sim.mjs v4's verified no_variety_dominates_any_multi_candidate_month=true).
visual_affordance: Committed variety card gets a clear orange border/background change; the '?' disclosure is a visibly bordered circular button (same visual language as clue_join's dx-more) — verified live via screenshot.
no_manual: No instructional/how-to-play text anywhere in the screen; card meaning is discoverable via tap and the '?' disclosure only, plus one shared learning-setting disclaimer line below the cards, matching no_manual_exploit_check_v5.json and every sibling Q1 game's convention.
job_reveal: onComplete/onPartialComplete both route to the existing shared Q1 shell, which renders schoolLunch.ts's unchanged farmer-lunch discoveryEcho/resolution/seed-picker — verified live end to end for both the success path (🎉 にんじん300kg、収穫！) and the honest-partial path (🤔 けっかを送ったけど、まだ全部はつながっていないかも — a genuinely different framing chip, not the success one).
